whatsNew.noNotes: No changelog entry for this version.
whatsNew.emptyBody: Releases appear here once plugins are tagged or have a changelog entry.
gs.title: Getting started
gs.lead: This site is a read-only catalog. You add the marketplace, install and update plugins from Claude Code.
gs.addBody: Run this once inside Claude Code. It registers the {marketplace} marketplace from GitHub.
gs.installBody: Install any plugin from the catalog by name. Dependencies are listed on each plugin page.
gs.updateBody: Refresh the marketplace to see new versions, then update the plugins you use.
gs.updatePluginCaption: Update one plugin from a terminal
gs.autoBody: Auto-update is off by default for third-party marketplaces. Run /plugin, open the Marketplaces tab, select {marketplace} and enable auto-update. Claude Code then refreshes the marketplace and updates installed plugins when it starts.
gs.teamBody: To set this up for a whole team, commit the marketplace and the plugins to enable in the project's .claude/settings.json. Team members are prompted to install them when they trust the folder.
gs.stableBody: {marketplace} is the latest channel: it follows the main branch. The repository also publishes a stable channel, a second marketplace named {marketplace}-stable that pins every plugin to a released tag. Add it and install plugins from it to stay on known releases.
gs.stableHint: Release tags are named <plugin>--v<version>. See the releases under
gs.rollbackBody: If a new version causes problems, move the plugin to the stable channel, and back to latest once it is fixed. From a clone of this repository, run the helper script in the project where the plugin is installed. It switches the marketplace, reinstalls the plugin with its dependencies and prunes what is no longer needed.
gs.rollbackManual: Without the script: uninstall the plugin from the latest channel, install it from the stable one, then run /reload-plugins.
